description: Shared test vectors for the Agent Bureau's review log (docs/review-log-design.md): review_log cases give a pinned genesis and the review organization's records in sequence order, and the reviewers they establish (null when no genesis takes effect); key_approvals cases give a reviewer's approval of a CounterAudit approval request. Built by scripts/review-vectors.ts in the-agent-bureau. The keys are test keys from fixed seeds.
